notes.title: 1.02 Patch
notes.content:
A small patch was issued today - you can tell whether you have the new version by looking for "1.02s" in the top right corner of the title screen.

This update adds more explanation the first time that you encounter an Intuition Mode puzzle:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243436/ecc401e0bd7efd9bc76ac8061618941e7ab08a87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243436/bf47aa1085708cc88ea7d349069fa283c2d9fa2f.png[/img][/url]

Hopefully this will make it more understandable for future players if they can see how to guess which direction to look for the Eye based on the curving lines. Wherever you click, you SHOULD get some clues that help you tell whether you're close or not and which way you should look next.

If this still makes no sense, comment and we'll see if we can elaborate further!

No new game content has been added, this is really more for the benefit of future players.

notes.title: 1.01 Patch
notes.content:
A small patch was issued today - you can tell whether you have the new version by looking for "1.01s" in the top right corner of the title screen.

This update:

[list]
[*] Fixes a typo
[*] Adds more backer names to the credits
[*] Hopefully fixes the crash problem on MacOS
[/list]

While we don't officially support MacOS, we do try to make it available. There was a problem causing a crash whenever achievement-related code tried to fire on MacOS, causing the game to crash at points such as the end of the commercial intro. This would happen even if the achievement had been previously unlocked. 

It should work now. But if it doesn't, or if you run into any other issues, please let us know!

notes.title: Launch!
notes.content: It's been a long time coming but finally we are live on Steam. We hope you enjoy the story we've laid out for you and look forward to the possibility of more mysteries to come!

notes.title: Teaser Demo available during Steam's Next Fest
notes.content: In preparation for our upcoming launch, a short teaser demo is being made available as part of Steam's NextFest. This demo will be removed when the full game launches, so if you want a chance to check it out, act now!

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.content: All artwork and features for this game have been implemented and a beta build has been sent out to backers for testing. We hope to have more information about release dates in the near future.

notes.title: Now Funding on Kickstarter
notes.content:
We're currently running a Kickstarter campaign to fund extra graphics (and possibly other additions?) to this title. The game WILL come out on Steam either way, but with the added support we can make it bigger, fancier, and better.

Hope to see you there!
